<Heading
  as={"h1"}

  children={"Preflight a campaign launch"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/campaign/{id}/preflight"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Runs the checks a launch with the same `executor` would run, without queueing anything: `ok` is false and `problems` says why when the launch would be refused. Both executors need a caller of the campaign's organization (`ACCOUNT_INVALID`) and an agent type the executor can run (`AGENT_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED`). The cloud also needs a cloud worker on this installation (`CLOUD_UNAVAILABLE`), the minimum credit balance (`INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS`), an agent and spec it can reach and load (`AGENT_NOT_CLOUD_RUNNABLE`, `AGENT_NEEDS_CONFIGURATION`, `SPEC_NOT_CLOUD_RUNNABLE`), every secret the spec references (`MISSING_SECRETS`), and a free slot under the organization's limit of concurrent cloud runs (`CLOUD_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT`).
